variants.instructions: Route this support ticket for the Pocketly app to one team. If it mentions more than one topic, pick the team that must act first on the main request. A bug that only looks like a billing problem is technical.

criteria.billing: Charges, refunds, prices, invoices, payment methods, discounts, trials and renewals.
criteria.technical: Bugs, crashes, slow performance, sync failures, broken features or display problems in the app.
criteria.account: Login, passwords, email changes, account deletion or closure, merging accounts, and account security.

variants.instructions: Which team should get this ticket?
